'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 2 Reid Smith DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' R. Smith
* '''Deck name:''' Iggy Smallz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
